item.description: A driver was killed in a violent high-speed crash overnight in Philadelphia that a veteran police captain called the worst he's ever seen.The deadly crash happened just before 1 a.m. on the 9400 block of Frankford Avenue. Investigators believe the driver was speeding down the street and struck a steel utility pole. item.description: A Pennsylvania inmate accused of fleeing police custody during a hospital visit in Philadelphia was captured near the state's capital.
